summary: Completed backend + frontend retest for requested scope. Rules Engine UI constraints, edit->PUT flow, auto-priority behavior, fail-safe 422, iteration51 regression (9/9), and setup EXE checks passed. One critical backend regression remains in deposit delete reversal flow.

critical.issue: delete_journal_for_source() reversal path overwrites original deposit/deposit_interest journal entries instead of creating separate reverse entries. Observed only 2 docs after delete (both is_reversal=true) with self-links (reversal_entry_id == id, reversal_of_entry_id == id).

action_items: Fix reversal creation for source-linked journals: when creating reverse entries, do not upsert by (source_type, source_id) into original row. Ensure a new journal id/entry_number is always inserted for reversal entries.
After fix, retest deposit delete flow to confirm original entries remain and gain reversal_entry_id, while new reverse entries get is_reversal=true + reversal_of_entry_id.
Keep manual DELETE /api/journal-entries/{id} behavior unchanged (currently correct and creates separate reversal entry).
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause is in save_journal_entry_document(): source-linked save uses find_one(query by source_type+source_id) then update_one by existing id, which is incompatible with reversal creation for the same source_id.
backend/server.py remains monolithic and high-risk for accounting regressions (>700 lines).
seed_data_creation: Created temporary journal/deposit records with ITER53 markers during API tests; deposit-delete path currently mutates source-linked journal rows due the reported bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI /rules-engine validated via Playwright: controlled selects (event/subtype/payment), account debit/credit selects include dynamic bank option, priority input hidden with Scoring+Specificity note, edit button populates form and save triggers PUT /api/rules-engine/rules/{id}, simulation preview renders. Backend: POST/PUT rules auto-priority passed; fail-safe unbalanced create returns 422; manual journal DELETE creates valid reversal; iteration51 regression is still 9/9 pass; /api/download/setup returns valid MZ EXE matching /app/dist/BankDepositSystemSetup.exe size.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: create deposit -> journal entries for source_type=deposit and deposit_interest exist -> call DELETE /api/banks/{bank_id}/deposits/{deposit_id}. Expected: original entries retained + new reverse entries created. Actual: save_journal_entry_document upserts existing row because reversal uses same source_type/source_id, so originals are overwritten and marked as reversal with self-references. Mitigation: add a force_new_entry path (or bypass source query) for reversal creation. MOCKED: Electronic Invoice external ETA submission remains MOCKED/BLOCKED pending official ETA SDK/credentials.
